# Amazon CloudFront
> Amazon CloudFront is AWS’s global content delivery network for securely delivering websites, APIs, video, and applications with low latency.

CloudFront documentation on aws.amazon.com covers getting started, distributions, security, edge compute, monitoring, pricing, and API/CLI reference material for managing CDN workloads at scale.

## Product Overview
- [Amazon CloudFront product page](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/): Overview of CloudFront features, use cases, performance, and integration with AWS services.
- [CloudFront features](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/features/): Summary of CDN, security, edge compute, streaming, and performance capabilities.
- [CloudFront pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/): Pricing details for data transfer, requests, edge functions, and related features.
- [CloudFront FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/faqs/): Answers to common questions about distributions, caching, security, and billing.
- [CloudFront global edge network](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/features/?nc=sn&loc=2): Information about edge locations, regional edge caches, and network reach.

## Developer Guide
- [CloudFront Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html): Main documentation for concepts, setup, configuration, and operations.
- [Getting started with CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/GettingStarted.html): Step-by-step introduction to creating and testing a distribution.
- [How CloudFront works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html): Explains request routing, caching behavior, and edge delivery flow.
- [Distributions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-working-with.html): Guidance for creating, updating, and managing CloudFront distributions.
- [Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html): Reference for cache behavior options and request handling controls.
- [Origins](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html): Details on using Amazon S3 and custom origins with CloudFront.
- [Invalidating files](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Invalidation.html): Instructions for removing cached objects from edge locations.

## Security and Access Control
- [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html): Configure origin access control and protect S3 content behind CloudFront.
- [Use signed URLs and signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html): Control access to private content using signed requests.
- [AWS WAF with CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-features.html): Protect CloudFront distributions with web ACLs and managed rules.
- [Field-level encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/field-level-encryption.html): Encrypt sensitive form fields between viewers and your application.
- [Geographic restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/georestrictions.html): Restrict content delivery based on viewer geographic location.
- [HTTPS and SSL/TLS certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https.html): Configure custom domains, certificates, and secure viewer connections.

## Edge Compute
- [Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-at-the-edge.html): Run Lambda functions at edge locations to customize request and response handling.
- [CloudFront Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cloudfront-functions.html): Lightweight JavaScript functions for high-scale edge request processing.
- [Choose between CloudFront Functions and Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-functions-choosing.html): Compare capabilities, performance, and use cases for edge compute options.
- [Event structure for Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-event-structure.html): Reference for CloudFront event payloads passed to Lambda@Edge functions.
- [Restrictions on edge functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-functions-restrictions.html): Limits, unsupported features, and operational constraints for edge functions.

## API, CLI, and Infrastructure as Code
- [CloudFront API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html): REST API reference for distributions, invalidations, policies, and related resources.
- [AWS CLI cloudfront command reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/cloudfront/index.html): Command reference for automating CloudFront management with the AWS CLI.
- [AWS SDK for JavaScript CloudFront examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-javascript/v3/developer-guide/javascript_cloudfront_code_examples.html): Code examples for managing CloudFront with the JavaScript SDK.
- [AWS SDK code examples for CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/code-library/latest/ug/cloudfront_code_examples.html): Multi-language SDK examples for common CloudFront operations.
- [AWS CloudFormation AWS::CloudFront::Distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-cloudfront-distribution.html): Resource reference for defining CloudFront distributions in CloudFormation.
- [AWS CDK CloudFront module](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/api/v2/docs/aws-cdk-lib.aws_cloudfront-readme.html): CDK constructs and examples for provisioning CloudFront resources.

## Monitoring and Operations
- [Monitor CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/monitoring-using-cloudwatch.html): Use CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards for CloudFront visibility.
- [CloudFront access logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/AccessLogs.html): Configure standard logging for requests served by CloudFront.
- [Real-time logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/real-time-logs.html): Stream detailed request logs in near real time for analytics and debugging.
- [CloudFront reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/programming-cloudwatch-metrics.html): Review usage metrics and traffic patterns for distributions.
- [Troubleshooting CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/troubleshooting-distributions.html): Diagnose common distribution, origin, caching, and certificate issues.

## Performance and Caching
- [Expiration and cache control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html): Control TTLs and caching behavior with headers and distribution settings.
- [Cache key and origin requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/controlling-the-cache-key.html): Configure cache policies and origin request policies for request variation.
- [Compression support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/ServingCompressedFiles.html): Enable automatic compression for supported content types.
- [Request and response behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorCustomOrigin.html): Understand how CloudFront handles headers, methods, and origin communication.
- [Improve performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IncreasingDistributionPerformance.html): Best practices for optimizing cache hit ratio and delivery speed.

## Media and Streaming
- [Deliver video on demand](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/on-demand-streaming.html): Use CloudFront to distribute on-demand media content efficiently.
- [Live streaming](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/live-streaming.html): Guidance for delivering live video streams through CloudFront.
- [HTTP streaming](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HTTPStreaming.html): Overview of supported HTTP streaming workflows and behaviors.
- [Serve private media content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-overview.html): Protect premium or restricted media with CloudFront access controls.

## Tutorials and AWS Resources
- [CloudFront workshops and tutorials](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/resources/): Curated CloudFront learning resources, tutorials, and additional technical content.
- [AWS networking and content delivery blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/): Blog posts covering CloudFront launches, architectures, and operational guidance.
- [What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html): Introductory explanation of CloudFront concepts and core terminology.
- [AWS re:Post CloudFront questions](https://repost.aws/tags/questions/TA5ZJ6W5jSSg6Q6K8mWwM2kA/amazon-cloudfront): Community Q&A for troubleshooting and implementation questions.
- [AWS architecture center](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/): Reference architectures and best practices relevant to CloudFront deployments.
